```promql
node_filesystem_files_free / node_filesystem_files * 100

# disk bandlik (saturation)
rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[5m])

# tarmoq xatolari
rate(node_network_receive_errs_total[5m])
```

| Resurs | Utilization | Saturation | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| CPU | busy % | load/cores, PSI | - |
| Memory | used % | swap, OOM kill, PSI | - |
| Disk | io_time | queue, await | I/O errors |
| Network | bytes/s | drops | errs |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `MemFree` ga qarash — Linux bo'sh xotirani page cache'ga ishlatadi, `MemFree` doim kichik ko'rinadi; to'g'risi `MemAvailable`.
- Inode tugashi ham "No space left on device" beradi, disk bo'sh ko'rinsa ham.
- Konteynerlar ichidagi xotira cgroup limiti bilan cheklangan — node metrikasi buni ko'rsatmaydi (cAdvisor kerak).

**Senior nuqta:** Pressure Stall Information (`node_pressure_*`) — saturation'ning eng aniq signali: "jarayonlar resurs kutib qancha vaqt yo'qotdi". Disk uchun `predict_linear` bilan "4 soatda to'ladi" alert'i — statik 90% dan foydaliroq.

33203.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bitta Prometheus vertikal o'sadi va lokal diskka bog'liq. Scale yo'llari: **HA juftlik** (ishonchlilik), **sharding** (target'larni bir nechta Prometheus'ga bo'lish), **recording rule va downsampling** (so'rov yuki), **remote_write -> Mimir/Thanos/VictoriaMetrics** (global so'rov va obyekt storage'da uzoq saqlash). **Federation** — eski usul, faqat agregatlar uchun.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
cluster A: Prometheus x2 (HA) --remote_write--\
cluster B: Prometheus x2      --remote_write---> Mimir / Thanos (S3, GCS)
cluster C: Prometheus agent   --remote_write--/         ^
                                                    Grafana (global query)
```

| Yondashuv | Nima beradi | Kamchilik |
|---|---|---|
| HA juftlik | bitta Prometheus o'lsa ham ishlaydi | dedup kerak |
| Federation | yuqori darajadagi agregatlar | xom data yo'q, mo'rt |
| Thanos sidecar | S3'da blok, global query | qo'shimcha komponentlar |
| remote_write + Mimir | markaziy, multi-tenant, uzoq saqlash | tarmoq, operatsion murakkablik |
| Agent mode | lokal so'rovsiz, faqat yuborish | lokal alert yo'q |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: https://mimir.example.com/api/v1/push
    queue_config: { max_samples_per_send: 5000, capacity: 20000 }
    write_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: "go_gc_.*|debug_.*"
        action: drop                  # keraksizlarini markazga yubormaslik
```
```promql
rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total[5m])     # yuborish xatolari
prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds
  - ignoring(remote_name, url) group_right prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds  # lag
```
Thanos compactor: eski ma'lumotni 5m va 1h rezolyutsiyaga downsampling qiladi — yillik so'rovlar tez.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Scale'ni kardinallikni tozalamasdan boshlash — muammoni qimmatroq joyga ko'chirish.
- remote_write lag'ini monitoring qilmaslik — markazda ma'lumot soatlab kechikadi.
- Hamma narsani markazga yuborish — narx; drop/aggregate qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** Arxitektura tanlovi: lokal alert'lar lokal Prometheus'da (tarmoq uzilsa ham ishlaydi), global ko'rinish va uzoq saqlash markaziy tizimda. "Scale muammosi" ning ko'pchiligi — keraksiz label'lar.

33204.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Region** — mustaqil geografik hudud (masalan, `eu-central-1` Frankfurt), ma'lumot qayerda yotishini belgilaydi. **Availability Zone** — region ichidagi alohida elektr, sovutish va tarmoqqa ega bir yoki bir nechta data center; AZ'lar past latency bilan bog'langan. **Edge location** — foydalanuvchiga yaqin nuqta: CloudFront CDN keshi va Route 53 DNS.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Region eu-central-1
  +-- AZ a (DC1, DC2)  <-- ~1-2 ms -->  AZ b  <-->  AZ c
Edge: Toshkent/Istanbul/... (CloudFront kesh, Route 53)
```

**Qaror mezonlari:**
| Daraja | Nimadan himoya | Narx/murakkablik |
|---|---|---|
| Single-AZ | hech narsadan | arzon |
| Multi-AZ | bitta DC yiqilishi (odatiy hodisa) | o'rtacha, standart prod |
| Multi-region | region darajasidagi falokat | qimmat, murakkab |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 describe-availability-zones --region eu-central-1 \
  --query 'AvailabilityZones[].[ZoneName,ZoneId]' --output table
```
Prod minimal: ALB + kamida 2 AZ'da instance/pod + RDS Multi-AZ.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- AZ nomi (`eu-central-1a`) har akkauntda boshqa jismoniy AZ'ga mos kelishi mumkin — akkauntlar aro moslash uchun `ZoneId` (`euc1-az2`) ishlating.
- AZ'lar orasidagi trafik pullik (~$0.01/GB har yo'nalish) — chatty servislar uchun sezilarli.
- Region tanlashda faqat narxga qarash — qonun (ma'lumot rezidentligi) va foydalanuvchiga latency muhimroq.
- Hamma servis hamma region'da yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Multi-region'ni faqat aniq RTO/RPO talabi bo'lsa qiling — u ma'lumot replikatsiyasi, konsistentlik va ikki baravar operatsion yuk demak. Ko'p tizim uchun yaxshi qurilgan multi-AZ yetarli.

33205.a:
**Qisqa javob:** EC2 — AWS'dagi virtual server. Instance type oilasi (CPU/xotira nisbati), hajmi va avlodi yuk profiliga qarab tanlanadi; keyin narx modeli (On-Demand, Savings Plans, Spot) ishlatish xarakteriga qarab. Tanlov o'lchovga asoslanishi kerak, taxminga emas.

**Nom o'qish:**
```
m7g.xlarge
| ||  +-- hajm (4 vCPU, 16 GiB)
| |+----- g = Graviton (ARM); i = Intel, a = AMD
| +------ avlod (7)
+-------- oila (m = umumiy)
```

| Oila | Nisbat | Qachon |
|---|---|---|
| t3/t4g | burstable | kichik, notekis yuk (CPU credit) |
| m7i/m7g | 1:4 | umumiy servislar |
| c7i/c7g | 1:2 | CPU-bound (API, encoding) |
| r7i/r7g | 1:8 | xotira (cache, DB) |
| g/p | GPU | ML, render |

**Narx modellari:**
| Model | Tejash | Qachon |
|---|---|---|
| On-Demand | - | noaniq, qisqa yuk |
| Savings Plans / RI | ~40-70% | 1-3 yillik barqaror baza |
| Spot | 90% gacha | stateless, batch; 2 daqiqa ogohlantirish bilan olib qo'yiladi |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-0abc... --instance-type t4g.small \
  --subnet-id subnet-123 --iam-instance-profile Name=app --user-data file://init.sh
aws ec2 describe-instance-types --instance-types m7g.large \
  --query 'InstanceTypes[].[VCpuInfo.DefaultVCpus,MemoryInfo.SizeInMiB]'
```
Tushunchalar: **AMI** — image, **user data** — birinchi boot skripti, **EBS** — disk, **instance profile** — IAM role.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `t` instance'da CPU credit tugasa keskin sekinlashadi — doimiy yuk uchun `m`/`c`.
- Graviton (ARM) uchun image `arm64` bo'lishi kerak.
- "Har ehtimolga qarshi" katta instance — CloudWatch/Compute Optimizer bilan rightsizing qiling.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval o'lchang (CPU, xotira, tarmoq), keyin oila tanlang; Graviton odatda ~20% arzon va tez. Bazaviy yukni Savings Plans bilan, cho'qqilarni On-Demand/Spot bilan qoplang.

33206.a:
**Qisqa javob:** S3 — cheksiz hajmli obyekt saqlash: fayllar (obyektlar) bucket'larda kalit bo'yicha HTTP API orqali saqlanadi. Juda yuqori chidamlilik (11 ta to'qqiz), strong read-after-write consistency, versioning, lifecycle, shifrlash va storage class'lar orqali narx nazorati.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
s3://acme-backups/2026/10/db.tar.gz
     |bucket      | kalit (prefiks + nom) -- papka yo'q, faqat "/" li kalit
PUT -> region ichida bir nechta AZ'ga nusxa -> 200 OK
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws s3 cp backup.tar.gz s3://acme-backups/2026/10/
aws s3 sync ./site s3://acme-site --delete
aws s3 presign s3://acme-files/video.mp4 --expires-in 3600   # vaqtinchalik havola
aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket acme-backups \
  --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled
```
Lifecycle:
```json
{ "Rules": [{ "ID": "archive", "Status": "Enabled", "Filter": { "Prefix": "logs/" },
  "Transitions": [{ "Days": 30, "StorageClass": "STANDARD_IA" },
                  { "Days": 90, "StorageClass": "GLACIER" }],
  "Expiration": { "Days": 365 } }] }
```

| Xususiyat | Nima uchun |
|---|---|
| Block Public Access | default yoqiq — shunday qolsin |
| Versioning | tasodifiy o'chirish/ustidan yozishdan himoya |
| SSE-S3 / SSE-KMS | shifrlash (SSE-S3 default), KMS — kalit nazorati va audit |
| Presigned URL | klient to'g'ridan S3'ga yuklaydi, server orqali emas |
| Object Lock | WORM, ransomware'dan himoya |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bucket'ni public qilib sayt berish — CloudFront + Origin Access Control ishlating.
- Versioning yoqib lifecycle qo'ymaslik — eski versiyalar jimgina pul yeydi.
- Ko'p kichik obyektlar va Glacier — har obyekt uchun overhead va retrieval narxi.

**Senior nuqta:** S3 xarajati ko'pincha saqlashda emas, so'rovlar va egress'da. Public ma'lumot uchun CDN, ichki trafik uchun VPC gateway endpoint (NAT'siz, bepul).

33207.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **User** — doimiy credential'li shaxs yoki dastur; **group** — user'larga policy biriktirish uchun to'plam; **role** — qisqa muddatli credential beradigan, "kiyiladigan" identifikator (EC2, Lambda, boshqa akkaunt, SSO); **policy** — nima ruxsat/taqiqligini belgilovchi JSON hujjat. Zamonaviy amaliyot: odamlar SSO orqali role'ga, ilovalar role'ga — uzoq muddatli access key'siz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
So'rov: s3:GetObject arn:aws:s3:::acme-reports/q3.pdf
  explicit Deny bormi?          -> ha -> RAD
  SCP / permission boundary ruxsat beradimi? -> yo'q -> RAD
  identity/resource policy Allow? -> ha -> RUXSAT, yo'q -> RAD (default deny)
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::acme-reports/*"
  }]
}
```
```bash
aws sts get-caller-identity                     # men kimman
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/deployer --role-session-name ci
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/app \
  --action-names s3:GetObject --resource-arns arn:aws:s3:::acme-reports/q3.pdf
```

| Kim | To'g'ri usul |
|---|---|
| Odam | IAM Identity Center (SSO) + MFA |
| EC2 / ECS / Lambda | role (instance profile, task role) |
| EKS pod | IRSA yoki EKS Pod Identity |
| CI (GitHub Actions) | OIDC -> role |
| Root | faqat favqulodda, MFA bilan |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `"Action": "*"` yoki `"Resource": "*"` — least privilege buziladi; IAM Access Analyzer bilan qisqartiring.
- Ilovaga access key berish — oqib ketadi, rotation qilinmaydi.
- Resource policy (bucket policy) va identity policy'ning birgalikdagi ta'sirini unutish — akkauntlar aro kirishda ikkalasi ham kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Explicit Deny har doim ustun — SCP va permission boundary bilan "eng yomon holatda ham" chegaralarni qo'ying. IAM sozlamalarini Terraform'da saqlab, policy o'zgarishlarini review qiling.

33208.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **VPC** — AWS'dagi sizning izolyatsiyalangan virtual tarmog'ingiz (CIDR, masalan `10.0.0.0/16`). **Subnet** — VPC'ning bitta AZ'dagi bo'lagi. **Public** subnet — route table'da `0.0.0.0/0 -> Internet Gateway` bor; **private** — internetga faqat **NAT Gateway** orqali chiqadi (kirish yo'q). IGW — VPC'ni internetga ulaydi; NAT GW — private resurslarga faqat chiquvchi ulanish beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
              Internet
                 |
         [Internet Gateway]
                 |
  VPC 10.0.0.0/16
  +-- public 10.0.1.0/24 (AZ a) : ALB, NAT GW
  |        route 0.0.0.0/0 -> IGW
  +-- private 10.0.11.0/24 (AZ a): app (EC2/EKS)
  |        route 0.0.0.0/0 -> NAT GW (AZ a)
  +-- private 10.0.21.0/24 (AZ a): RDS (internetga yo'l yo'q)
  (AZ b, c da ham xuddi shunday)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-123 \
  --query 'RouteTables[].Routes[].[DestinationCidrBlock,GatewayId,NatGatewayId]' --output table
```
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source             = "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws"
  version            = "5.8.1"
  cidr               = "10.0.0.0/16"
  azs                = ["eu-central-1a", "eu-central-1b", "eu-central-1c"]
  public_subnets     = ["10.0.1.0/24", "10.0.2.0/24", "10.0.3.0/24"]
  private_subnets    = ["10.0.11.0/24", "10.0.12.0/24", "10.0.13.0/24"]
  enable_nat_gateway = true
  one_nat_gateway_per_az = true
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bitta NAT GW — u turgan AZ yiqilsa hamma private subnet'lar internetsiz qoladi; prod'da har AZ'ga bittadan.
- NAT GW pullik (soat + har GB) — S3/DynamoDB uchun gateway VPC endpoint (bepul), ECR/STS uchun interface endpoint.
- Kichik yoki boshqa tarmoqlar bilan kesishadigan CIDR — keyin peering/VPN qilib bo'lmaydi. EKS pod'lari ko'p IP yeydi.

**Senior nuqta:** CIDR rejasi — qaytarib bo'lmaydigan qaror: butun tashkilot uchun IPAM bilan, kelajakdagi VPC'lar, ofis va on-prem tarmoqlari bilan kesishmaydigan qilib reja tuzing.

33209.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Security Group** — instance (ENI) darajasidagi **stateful** firewall: faqat allow qoidalari, javob trafigi avtomatik ruxsat, manba sifatida boshqa SG'ga murojaat qilish mumkin. **NACL** — subnet darajasidagi **stateless** filtr: allow va deny, raqam tartibida, javob trafigi (ephemeral portlar) uchun alohida qoida kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Internet -> [NACL subnet chegarasi: kirish + chiqish alohida tekshiriladi]
              -> [SG instance: kirish tekshiriladi, javob avtomatik o'tadi] -> EC2
```

| | Security Group | NACL |
|---|---|---|
| Daraja | ENI (instance) | subnet |
| State | stateful | stateless |
| Qoidalar | faqat allow | allow + deny, raqam tartibida |
| Manba | CIDR yoki **boshqa SG** | faqat CIDR |
| Default | kirish yopiq | default NACL hammasini ochadi |

**Amalda:**
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule" "db_from_app" {
  security_group_id            = aws_security_group.db.id
  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.app.id   # IP emas, SG
  from_port                    = 5432
  to_port                      = 5432
  ip_protocol                  = "tcp"
}
```
```bash
aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-123 \
  --query 'SecurityGroups[].IpPermissions'
# SSH o'rniga:
aws ssm start-session --target i-0abc123
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `0.0.0.0/0` dan 22/3389-port — internetdan doimiy brute-force; SSM Session Manager ishlating.
- NACL'da ephemeral portlarni (1024-65535) chiqishga ochishni unutish — ulanishlar "osilib" qoladi.
- SG qoidasida IP manzil — autoscaling'da IP o'zgaradi, qoida eskiradi; SG reference ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy himoya — SG'lar orasidagi "kim kim bilan gaplashadi" grafi (app -> db). NACL — qo'pol vosita (ma'lum CIDR'ni bloklash, compliance). Ikkalasini ham Terraform'da boshqaring va AWS Config bilan "ochiq SSH" ni avtomatik aniqlang.

33210.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ALB** — L7 (HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC) load balancer: host, path, header bo'yicha routing, TLS termination, WAF, Cognito/OIDC auth. **NLB** — L4 (TCP/UDP/TLS): juda past latency, millionlab ulanish, statik/Elastic IP, client IP'ni saqlash. HTTP API va veb uchun ALB; TCP protokollar, statik IP yoki ekstremal throughput uchun NLB.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ALB: client --HTTPS--> ALB (TLS tugaydi, so'rov o'qiladi)
       /api/*  -> TG api       host: admin.* -> TG admin
NLB: client --TCP--> NLB (paketni o'qimaydi) --> TG (target'lar, client IP saqlanadi)
```

| | ALB | NLB |
|---|---|---|
| Qatlam | L7 | L4 |
| Routing | path, host, header, query | port |
| TLS | termination, SNI | passthrough yoki termination |
| IP | o'zgaruvchan (DNS orqali) | statik / Elastic IP |
| WAF | bor | yo'q |
| Misol | REST API, veb, gRPC | MQTT, DB proxy, o'yin serveri, PrivateLink |

**Amalda:**
```hcl
resource "aws_lb_target_group" "api" {
  port                 = 8080
  protocol             = "HTTP"
  vpc_id               = module.vpc.vpc_id
  deregistration_delay = 30            # connection draining
  health_check {
    path                = "/healthz"
    matcher             = "200"
    interval            = 10
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 3
  }
}
```
```bash
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn $TG \
  --query 'TargetHealthDescriptions[].[Target.Id,TargetHealth.State,TargetHealth.Reason]'
```
K8s'da: AWS Load Balancer Controller — Ingress -> ALB, Service `type: LoadBalancer` -> NLB.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Health check `/` ga va u DB'ni tekshiradi — DB sekinlashsa hamma target "nosog'lom" bo'lib, butun servis yiqiladi. Liveness'ni yengil qiling.
- Deregistration delay juda katta — deploy sekin; juda kichik — so'rovlar uziladi.
- ALB idle timeout (60s) va ilova keep-alive mos emas — tasodifiy 502'lar.

**Senior nuqta:** 502/504 tahlilida ALB access log'lari (`target_processing_time`, `elb_status_code` vs `target_status_code`) muammo LB'dami yoki ilovadami — darhol ajratadi.

33211.a:
**Qisqa javob:** RDS — managed relyatsion DB (PostgreSQL, MySQL va h.k.): AWS OS/engine patch, avtomatik backup, PITR, Multi-AZ failover va monitoringni o'z zimmasiga oladi. **Multi-AZ** — HA (sinxron standby, avtomatik failover); **read replica** — o'qishni scale qilish (asinxron, lag bor). Backup'lar avtomatik snapshot + transaction log orqali istalgan soniyaga tiklash.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
app -> endpoint (DNS) -> primary (AZ a) ==sinxron==> standby (AZ b)   [Multi-AZ]
                               \--asinxron--> read replica (o'qish)
primary yiqildi -> DNS standby'ga ~60-120s
backup: kunlik snapshot + 5 daqiqalik log -> PITR (yangi instance)
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
  identifier                  = "prod-db"
  engine                      = "postgres"
  engine_version              = "16.4"
  instance_class              = "db.m7g.large"
  multi_az                    = true
  storage_encrypted           = true
  backup_retention_period     = 14
  deletion_protection         = true
  manage_master_user_password = true
  db_subnet_group_name        = aws_db_subnet_group.private.name
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.db.id]
  performance_insights_enabled = true
}
```
```bash
aws rds restore-db-instance-to-point-in-time --source-db-instance-identifier prod-db \
  --target-db-instance-identifier prod-db-restore --restore-time 2026-10-02T09:10:00Z
aws rds reboot-db-instance --db-instance-identifier prod-db --force-failover   # failover testi
```

| | Multi-AZ | Read replica |
|---|---|---|
| Maqsad | HA | o'qish scale |
| Replikatsiya | sinxron | asinxron (lag) |
| O'qish uchun | yo'q (Multi-AZ cluster bundan mustasno) | ha |
| Failover | avtomatik | qo'lda promote |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PITR **yangi** instance yaratadi — endpoint o'zgaradi; ilova konfiguratsiyasini yangilash rejasi kerak.
- Ko'p ulanish (Lambda, yuzlab pod) — `max_connections` tugaydi; RDS Proxy yoki PgBouncer.
- Ilova DNS'ni keshlab qolsa failover'dan keyin eski IP'ga ulanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Tiklanmagan backup — backup emas: muntazam ravishda restore'ni sinab, RTO'ni o'lchang. Aurora (storage 3 AZ'da 6 nusxa, tezroq failover) qimmatroq, lekin yuqori talablarda ko'rib chiqiladi.

33212.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CloudWatch — AWS'ning monitoring servisi: **Metrics** (servislar avtomatik yuboradigan va custom metrikalar), **Logs** (log guruhlari, Logs Insights so'rovlari), **Alarms** (metrika chegarani kesib o'tsa SNS/Auto Scaling harakati). Qo'shimcha: dashboard'lar, EventBridge bilan bog'liq hodisalar, Container Insights.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
EC2/ALB/RDS --metrika (1-5 daq)--> CloudWatch Metrics --> Alarm (CPU > 80% 3 x 5m)
                                                            -> SNS -> PagerDuty / Slack
app / ECS / Lambda --log--> Log group /ecs/api --> Logs Insights so'rovi
CloudWatch agent (EC2) --> memory, disk, custom metrikalar
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws logs tail /ecs/api --follow --since 10m
aws logs put-retention-policy --log-group-name /ecs/api --retention-in-days 30
aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --state-value ALARM
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name alb-5xx --namespace AWS/ApplicationELB \
  --metric-name HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count --dimensions Name=LoadBalancer,Value=app/web/123 \
  --statistic Sum --period 60 --evaluation-periods 5 --threshold 50 \
  --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold --alarm-actions arn:aws:sns:eu-central-1:111:oncall
```
Logs Insights:
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter level = "error"
| stats count() by bin(5m)
```

**Muhim alarm'lar:** ALB 5xx va target response time, unhealthy host count, RDS CPU / FreeStorageSpace / DatabaseConnections, SQS DLQ xabarlari, billing.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Default EC2 metrikalarida **xotira va disk yo'q** — CloudWatch agent o'rnating.
- Log retention default "Never expire" — xarajat jimgina o'sadi.
- Custom metrikada yuqori kardinallikli dimension (user_id) — har kombinatsiya alohida pullik metrika.

**Senior nuqta:** CloudWatch xarajati ko'pincha log ingestion'da. Log darajasini boshqaring, keraksiz debug log'larni yubormang va retention qo'ying; simptom-asosli alarm'lar (5xx, latency) resurs alarm'laridan muhimroq.

33213.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Junior uchun asosiy narsalar: **AWS Budgets** alert'lari, har resursda **tag**'lar (team, env, service), Cost Explorer bilan kim qancha sarflashini ko'rish, dev muhitni ishlamagan vaqtda o'chirish, yetim resurslarni tozalash va "yashirin" xarajatlarni (NAT, trafik, log'lar) bilish.

**Qayerdan pul ketadi:**
```
compute (EC2, Fargate)    -- ko'pincha eng katta qism
storage (EBS, snapshot, S3)
tarmoq: NAT GW (soat + GB), AZ'lar aro trafik, internetga egress   <- yashirin
CloudWatch Logs ingestion                                          <- yashirin
```

33215.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `nginx -t` — konfiguratsiyani sintaksis va mantiq bo'yicha tekshiradi, hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi. `reload` — master yangi config'ni o'qib yangi worker'lar ochadi, eskilari joriy so'rovlarni tugatib chiqadi (uzilishsiz). `restart` — jarayonni to'liq to'xtatib qayta ishga tushiradi (ulanishlar uziladi).

**Nega muhim:** xato config bilan `restart` nginx'ni umuman o'chirib qo'yadi — barcha saytlar yotadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
reload (SIGHUP):
  master: yangi config o'qiydi -- xato? --> eski config'da qoladi, error.log'ga yozadi
            | ok
            v
  yangi worker'lar start -> eski worker'lar "graceful": joriy so'rovni tugatib chiqadi

restart:
  stop (hamma ulanish uziladi) -> start (xato bo'lsa: nginx o'chiq qoladi!)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo nginx -t
# nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok
# nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx     # xavfsiz odat
sudo nginx -T | less          # include'lar bilan yig'ilgan to'liq config
sudo systemctl status nginx
sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log
```
Fayllar: `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf`, `/etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf`, Debian'da `sites-available/` + `sites-enabled/` (symlink).

| Holat | Nima ishlatish |
|---|---|
| config o'zgardi | `reload` |
| nginx binary yangilandi | `restart` (yoki binary upgrade USR2) |
| sertifikat yangilandi | `reload` |
| `listen` / worker soni o'zgardi | odatda `reload` yetadi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `nginx -t` fayl tizimini tekshirmaydi: `proxy_pass` qilingan backend tirikmi — bilmaydi.
- `sites-available`da yangi fayl bor, lekin `sites-enabled`ga symlink unutilgan — config "ishlamaydi".
- `nginx -t` boshqa foydalanuvchi bilan ishlatilsa sertifikat kalitini o'qiy olmay xato beradi — `sudo` bilan.
- Uzoq WebSocket ulanishlari reload'dan keyin eski worker'larni uzoq ushlaydi — `worker_shutdown_timeout`.

**Senior nuqta:** Config'ni git'da saqla, CI'da `nginx -t` (docker image ichida) ishlat, deploy'da `-t && reload`. Reload'dan keyin smoke test (`curl` health) — sintaksis to'g'ri bo'lishi mantiq to'g'riligini kafolatlamaydi.

33216.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval **server** tanlanadi: `listen` (IP:port) mos kelganlar ichidan `Host` header `server_name`ga solishtiriladi; topilmasa `default_server` (yoki shu port'dagi birinchi server). Keyin **location**: `=` aniq moslik -> eng uzun prefiks (agar `^~` bo'lsa shu yerda to'xtaydi) -> regex'lar fayldagi tartibda (`~`, `~*`) -> topilmasa eslab qolingan eng uzun prefiks.

**Nega muhim:** noto'g'ri tartib sababli `/api/` so'rovi statik location'ga tushadi yoki begona domen sizning saytingizni ochadi.

**Location tanlash algoritmi:**
```
URI keldi
  |
  +-- "= /uri" aniq mos?  --> ha: shu, tamom
  |
  +-- barcha prefiks location'lar ichidan eng uzunini eslab qol
  |      bu "^~" bilanmi? --> ha: shu, regex tekshirilmaydi
  |
  +-- regex'lar (~ / ~*) fayldagi tartibda: birinchi mos --> shu
  |
  +-- regex yo'q --> eslab qolingan eng uzun prefiks
```

**Amalda:**
```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name example.com www.example.com;

    location = /healthz        { return 200 "ok\n"; }          # 1. aniq
    location ^~ /static/       { root /var/www; }               # 2. prefiks, regex'siz
    location ~* \.(png|jpg)$   { expires 30d; }                 # 3. regex
    location /api/             { proxy_pass http://api; }       # 4. eng uzun prefiks
    location /                 { proxy_pass http://web; }       # 5. qolgan hammasi
}
```
| So'rov | Tushadigan location |
|---|---|
| `/healthz` | `= /healthz` |
| `/static/a.png` | `^~ /static/` (regex emas) |
| `/img/a.png` | `~* \.(png|jpg)$` |
| `/api/a.png` | regex! (`/api/` `^~` emas) |
| `/about` | `/` |

**Default server (himoya):**
```nginx
server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    listen 443 ssl default_server;
    ssl_reject_handshake on;    # noma'lum SNI'ga sertifikat ham bermaydi
    return 444;                 # javobsiz ulanishni yopadi
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `default_server`siz noma'lum Host (yoki to'g'ridan IP) bilan kelgan so'rov birinchi server'ga tushadi — boshqa saytingiz ochilib qoladi, Host header injection'ga yo'l.
- Regex location prefiks'dan ustun — `/api/x.png` kutilmaganda statik qoidaga tushadi.
- `root` vs `alias` farqi: `alias` location prefiksini almashtiradi, `root` qo'shadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Murakkab config'da `nginx -T` va `curl -H 'Host: ...'` bilan har muhim yo'lni test qil; regex'ni kam ishlat — tartibga bog'liqlik xatolarning asosiy manbai.

33217.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `certbot` Let's Encrypt (ACME protokoli) orqali bepul sertifikat oladi: domen sizniki ekanini HTTP-01 (80-portda maxsus fayl) yoki DNS-01 (TXT yozuv) bilan isbotlaydi. `certbot --nginx` sertifikatni o'rnatadi, systemd timer kuniga ikki marta tekshirib, muddat tugashiga ~30 kun qolganda yangilaydi.

**Nega muhim:** sertifikat 90 kunlik (va qisqaroq muddatlarga o'tish rejalashtirilgan) — qo'lda yangilash albatta unutiladi. Avtomatlashtirish majburiy.

**Qanday ishlaydi (HTTP-01):**
```
certbot --> Let's Encrypt: "example.com uchun sertifikat"
        <-- token: http://example.com/.well-known/acme-challenge/<token> ni joylashtir
certbot: faylni joylaydi
LE ---- GET (80-port, internetdan) ----> nginx -> token mos -> tasdiq
        <-- sertifikat (fullchain.pem + privkey.pem)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx
sudo certbot --nginx -d example.com -d www.example.com
# fayllar: /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/{fullchain.pem,privkey.pem}

sudo certbot certificates                 # domenlar va muddatlar
sudo certbot renew --dry-run              # yangilash sinovi
systemctl list-timers | grep certbot      # avtomatik yangilash timer'i

# Wildcard -- faqat DNS-01 (DNS provayder plugin bilan)
sudo certbot certonly --dns-cloudflare --dns-cloudflare-credentials /root/cf.ini -d '*.example.com'
```
Yangilangandan keyin nginx yangi faylni o'qishi kerak: `--deploy-hook 'systemctl reload nginx'` (yoki `/etc/letsencrypt/renewal-hooks/deploy/`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 80-port firewall/SG'da yopiq yoki hamma narsa 443'ga redirect qilinib challenge yo'li buzilgan — HTTP-01 yiqiladi.
- Rate limit (domen bo'yicha haftalik limit) — tajriba uchun `--staging`.
- Sertifikat yangilandi, lekin nginx reload qilinmadi — eski sertifikat xotirada, muddati o'tadi.
- DNS API token'i (DNS-01) faqat kerakli zona va TXT yozuvga cheklansin — u butun domeningiz kaliti.

**Senior nuqta:** Muddatni tashqaridan monitoring qil (`blackbox_exporter` `probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry` < 14 kun alert). Ko'p serverli muhitda sertifikat bitta joyda (LB, cert-manager, ACM) boshqarilsin, har serverda alohida certbot emas.

33220.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **502 Bad Gateway** — nginx backend'dan umuman yaroqli javob ololmadi (ulanish rad etildi, uzildi, noto'g'ri javob). **504 Gateway Timeout** — backend'ga ulandi, lekin belgilangan vaqtda (`proxy_read_timeout`, default 60s) javob kelmadi. Debug har doim `error.log`dan boshlanadi.

**Farq:**
```
nginx --connect--> backend
   x  Connection refused / reset / socket yo'q        -> 502 (backend o'lik yoki noto'g'ri port)
   ok --so'rov--> ... 60s jimlik ...                   -> 504 (backend sekin/osilgan)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log
# connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream   -> 502: app ishlamayapti
# recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)                              -> 502: app ulanishni uzdi
# upstream prematurely closed connection                                    -> 502: app crash/keepalive
# connect() to unix:/run/app.sock failed (13: Permission denied)            -> 502: socket huquqi/SELinux
# upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response     -> 504: app sekin
# no live upstreams while connecting to upstream                            -> hamma backend chiqarilgan

systemctl status app
ss -tlnp | grep 8080                          # app shu portda tinglayaptimi
curl -sv http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz        # nginx'siz to'g'ridan
curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8080/slow
```
Access log formatiga `$upstream_status $upstream_response_time` qo'sh — qaysi endpoint va backend sekinligi ko'rinadi.

SELinux (RHEL): `(13: Permission denied)` tarmoq ulanishida -> `sudo setsebool -P httpd_can_network_connect 1`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- 504'ni `proxy_read_timeout 600s` bilan "tuzatish" — simptomni yashiradi; worker'lar band bo'lib qoladi. Sekin query/tashqi API'ni top.
- Deploy paytidagi qisqa 502'lar — app graceful shutdown qilmayapti yoki health check yo'q.
- App'ning keepalive timeout'i nginx'nikidan qisqa — nginx yopilgan ulanishga yozadi, tasodifiy 502.

**Senior nuqta:** 5xx'ni upstream bo'yicha metrikaga chiqar (RED). 502 — mavjudlik muammosi, 504 — latency muammosi; ularni alohida alert qil, chunki root cause va ishchi jamoa har xil.
